methods.selection: Random permutation of original20k held-out boards, seed141237; take first1000 eligible. Focal corners are original top-two A1 logits. Eligible equal-number resource swaps touch neither focal corner and change their exact worst-reply resource-coverage contrast. Choose largest absolute contrast change, then largest all-five-complement-count contrast change, then hex IDs. No evaluation of changed-board policy used in selection.
methods.control: Swap two non-desert resource labels at equal-number hexes. All number tokens, resource inventory, every corner total pips, board-wide pips for each resource, ports and both focal raw vertex rows stay fixed. Native engine reconstructs both boards. All path/global input entries also verified identical.
methods.activation: At input embedding boundary, replace only changed hex embeddings, only derived vertex embeddings, or both with their donor values; all unchanged rows are equal. Rerun complete trunk and settlement head. Identity and full-change positive controls pass.
methods.directional_transfer: sum(patched margin shift × full margin shift) / sum(full margin shift²). Signed projection, not explained variance or percentage of a concept; pathways interact and transfers need not sum to1.
methods.uncertainty: One paired board counterfactual each; normal95%CI for board means and delta-method95%CI for projection. Conditional on selected counterfactual family and frozen policy.
methods.limitation: Remote resource swaps also change expansion and distant-port opportunities; a relationship with coverage robustness does not isolate a fallback algorithm or prove minimax planning.
